messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — Luminara dedicated pool go-live next Tue. Need final confirmation on quota split, autoscale policy, and load test windows. Who can ✅ by EOD?
Pranav Reddy: I can take quota + autoscale. Proposal: 3 reserved instances (r4), burstable to 6 for 1 hour windows, soft limit at 8. Reason: onboarding spike + demo traffic.
Nora Chen: I’ll own load tests. Plan: three phases — smoke, steady-state (6h), soak (24h). Metrics: p50/p95/p99, errors, GPU util, KV cache hit.
Jasmine (CSM - Luminara): Thanks — customer asks for a midday run to match their traffic (US/EU overlap). Prefer Tue 14:00-18:00 PT. Also want failover behavior documented.
Eli Gomez: Noted on failover. We’ll have routing policy: primary -> dedicated, fallback -> hosted-compatible model in same region. Will surface model mismatch warnings.
Pranav Reddy: Autoscale snippet (rough):
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 8
  cpu_threshold: 65
  gpu_util_threshold: 78
  cooldown: 90s
  burst_window: 3600s
```
Nora Chen: Load generator command (phase 2):
`k6 run --vus 250 --duration 6h script.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086`
Will tag tests with `luminara-dedicated-2026-03-24` for correlation.
Maya Patel: Customer wants quota numbers in writing + rollback plan. Pranav, can you add the reserve commit numbers and the rollback trigger thresholds?
Pranav Reddy: Reserve commit: 3 instances (baseline), billing cap set to 9. Rollback triggers: p99 latency > 1200ms for 10m OR error rate > 2% over 5m -> initiate immediate traffic drain to hosted.
InfraBot: Deploy event: reserved-pool/luminara v2026.03.23 queued by @pranav — ETA 2026-03-24T13:45Z.
Eli Gomez: I'll add an automatic routing rule: if replicas < 2 for 5m then shift 30% traffic to hosted variant, 100% after 10m. Also add cached-prefix sync TTL 2h to reduce cold-starts.
Jasmine (CSM - Luminara): Can you also confirm data isolation — logs stored in customer-owned S3? Legal asked.
Pranav Reddy: Confirmed — logs and audit are in customer S3 bucket (encrypted). Access keys provisioned to their security team.
Nora Chen: Test checklist I’ll post after lunch. Items: warm cache walk-through, canary with 5% traffic for 30m, full load steady-state, regression evals vs golden prompts, and failure scenarios.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Owners: Pranav (quota + rollback), Nora (load tests + metrics), Eli (routing + fallback), Jasmine (customer comms). Can everyone react when done? :thumbsup:
Pranav Reddy: ✅
Nora Chen: ✅
Eli Gomez: ✅
Jasmine (CSM - Luminara): ✅
Maya Patel: I'll schedule the go/no-go call Mon 10:00 PT and post the runbook link: https://console.redwood.ai/teams/luminara/dedicated/runbooks/readiness. Thanks all.
